name: adb-plugin-server-logs
description: Comprehensive server logging plugin for tracking member changes, message edits/deletes, moderation actions, voice events, channel changes, and server boosts.
author: DeadIndian

process.persistentReason: Runs un-isolated (system:raw-client) to fetch audit logs (fetchAuditLogs), read message content and member caches, and inspect voice/channel state on every event — discord.js audit-log and cache APIs are outside the sandboxed RPC surface.

permissions.label: Configure
permissions.description: Set log channels, categories, and retention.

permissions.label: View logs
permissions.description: Read the stored/cached message log history.

enabled.description: Enable this plugin for the server

membersChannelId.description: Channel ID for member join/leave/update logs

messagesChannelId.description: Channel ID for message edit/delete logs

voiceChannelId.description: Channel ID for voice state logs

channelsChannelId.description: Channel ID for channel create/update/delete logs

boostsChannelId.description: Channel ID for server boost logs

retentionDays.description: Days to keep cached messages for edit/delete logging
